question: What is WeIntern?
answer: WeIntern is an EdTech platform (we-intern.in) where students don't wait for opportunity — they build it. WeIntern provides industry-focused internship programs with live projects, mentor support, verified certificates, and stipend opportunities across 7 domains.

question: Does WeIntern offer internships?
answer: Yes. WeIntern offers structured internship programs in Full Stack Web Development, Mobile App Development, AI & Automation, Cloud Solutions & DevOps, UI/UX Design, Digital Marketing, and Data Science & Analytics.

question: How do I apply for an internship?
answer: To apply: 1) Visit we-intern.in and choose your domain. 2) Complete the registration form. 3) Pay the program fee via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking). 4) Receive enrollment confirmation, WhatsApp group invite, and orientation details on your registered email and WhatsApp.

question: Is WeIntern genuine?
answer: Yes. WeIntern is a legitimate EdTech platform operating at we-intern.in. You can contact the team at +91 74149 74582 (WhatsApp) or contact.weintern@gmail.com to verify any program details before enrolling.

question: What is the WeIntern website?
answer: The official WeIntern website is we-intern.in. You can explore all 7 program domains, fees, curriculum details, and enroll directly from there.

question: Can freshers join WeIntern?
answer: Yes. WeIntern is designed for students and freshers. Programs like Full Stack Web Development, UI/UX Design, and Digital Marketing are explicitly beginner-level. No prior experience required.

question: Will I get a real certificate?
answer: Yes. Upon successful completion of the program and required projects, you receive a WeIntern verified certificate that you can add to your LinkedIn profile.

question: Is there a stipend?
answer: Yes. Stipend opportunities are available across all WeIntern programs. The stipend is performance-based and awarded after completing real client projects.
